text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That was an exquisite display of skill.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This Paka Petit...
May I truly have it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That must be the fruit of your hard work.
choice_data_list: I believe it would be most fitting to keep it by your side, Lady Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Then I shall partake without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Pisa mentioned that she was searching for a companion for her Paka Petit.
Let us go pay our respects without delay.
